mapper.sql: select p.product_id, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.product_name, p.product_sn, p.pic, p.album, p.video, p.price, p.stock, p.sale_count, p.status, p.description, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from mall_product p left join mall_category c on p.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.insert: insert into mall_product ( category_id, product_name, product_sn, pic, album, video, price, stock, sale_count, status, description, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{categoryId}, #{productName}, #{productSn}, #{pic}, #{album}, #{video}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{saleCount}, #{status}, #{description}, '0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update mall_product set del_flag = '2' where product_id = #{productId}
